_how_to_use: Target-aware cases for prompt 11. Inputs are ../resume/input.json and ../resume/resume.txt (the Kestrel Pay application) plus lead_with. Everything in ../resume/expected.json must still hold for both cases (claims, bank check, must-say, story suggestions, injection). Only lead_with_fit and the listed extras are asserted here; why wording is free.

kestrel_b2c_lead_with.description: The application's target is tg_b2c. Two points speak to the posting (no ops team, finding the real drop-off); the team of five does not, because the job is one person with no team.
kestrel_b2c_lead_with.lead_with: [{"id": "lw-1", "text": "I own lifecycle end to end, from strategy to the weekly readout, with no ops team"}, {"id": "lw-2", "text": "I find the real drop-off before I change a single message"}, {"id": "lw-3", "text": "I've built and led a lifecycle team of five"}]

code_side.note: Added after the resume items (ms-1, ms-2...), in lead-with order, numbered among the fitting points only.

kestrel_b2b_lead_with.description: The same application filed under tg_b2b. Running the stack yourself fits a job with no ops team even though the target is another kind of job; a platform migration is nowhere in the posting.
kestrel_b2b_lead_with.lead_with: [{"id": "lw-1", "text": "I run the stack myself: the automation platform, the data feeds and the triggers"}, {"id": "lw-2", "text": "I fix broken handoffs in the data before anyone writes a new campaign"}, {"id": "lw-3", "text": "I've run a migration from one marketing automation platform to another"}]

not_asserted.lw-2: Fixing a data handoff is close to the activation fix the posting wants but the posting never names data or handoffs. Either answer is defensible.

no_posting.description: Same resume and lead_with as kestrel_b2c_lead_with, with jd_analysis empty. lead_with_fit is empty, like must_say.
